name: @hl-bos/presence-scanner
description: HLG Presence Scanner engine. Finds local businesses (Google Places or an imported list), inspects each website through the existing SSRF-safe HL-BOS website scanner, scores the opportunity with a deterministic, versioned, evidence-backed rubric, qualifies and de-duplicates leads, and exports them. No storage of its own: it talks to a repository interface. No AI in the score.
